comparison.objective: Safely assemble a grinding wheel stack on a grinder spindle; unlike screening media from parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered coaxial placement, thread tightening with torque control, and clamp validation versus controlled pouring and agitation of free bodies.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the good wheel and stack components correctly seated, safe torque, nut engagement, spin and pull retention tests, and rejects the damaged wheel; candidate requires media recovery and washer retention. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: It evaluates safety-critical rotating-tool assembly and force control, not granular sorting.
